🔥 The fire settles. Desmond has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Heckler — I put it down today." "'You call that a swing?' The words CUT. Shame stacks." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

Yuki asks "We've been walking past those." Carlos asks "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
